author: ReelKevin
quote: After years of waiting, GTA 6 feels like a massive letdown. It’s nothing like GTA V. Instead, it feels like Red Dead Redemption 2 mixed with Watch Dogs, stripped of the chaotic humor, edgy satire, and freedom that made Grand Theft Auto **** story feels incredibly forced and boring. Being pushed into a romantic relationship and having to do mundane activities like buying flowers, painting walls, and fixing up a house is not what I want from a GTA game. I bought Grand Theft Auto, not a domestic life **** feels like modern woke and feminist messaging has taken priority over the humor, controversy, and unapologetic personality that defined this franchise. Representation isn’t the issue; forcing social messaging and mundane relationship mechanics into a game at the expense of entertainment is.Rockstar seems afraid to push boundaries anymore. I wanted the outrageous, unpredictable GTA experience I grew up loving, not a sanitized open-world simulator. Honestly, I want my money back. What a disappointment
